description: This lexicon is in a not officially released state. It is subject to change. | An emoji reaction to a teal.fm play or post.

main.description: Record containing one emoji reaction. An actor may react to the same subject with several different emoji, one record each.

subject.description: The play (fm.teal.feed.play) or post (fm.teal.feed.social.post) being reacted to.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this reaction was created.
